title: Signed flip of the total complex of an additive bifunctor
statement: Let $C_1,C_2$ and $D$ be preadditive categories [def-weil-preadditive-category], and let $B:C_1\times C_2\to D$ be a bifunctor additive in each variable. Let $P,Q$ be integer cochain complexes (with $d^2=0$) in $C_1,C_2$. Suppose the coproducts defining the direct-sum total complex exist. Write $\operatorname{Tot}_B(P,Q)^n=\bigoplus_{p+q=n}B(P^p,Q^q)$, with differential $B(d_P,1)+(-1)^pB(1,d_Q)$ on the $(p,q)$ summand, and $B^{\mathrm{flip}}(Y,X)=B(X,Y)$. There is a natural chain isomorphism $s:\operatorname{Tot}_{B^{\mathrm{flip}}}(Q,P)\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Tot}_B(P,Q)$. On the $(q,p)$ summand its hom is $(-1)^{pq}$ times the inclusion of $B(P^p,Q^q)$ into the $(p,q)$ summand. Its inverse has the same signed-inclusion formula with the indices interchanged. Naturality is with respect to maps of both complexes. In particular this is an isomorphism of complexes, rather than merely an isomorphism of their graded objects.
